description: Read the DNS records VibeDeploy tracks for a site (the records it created/manages on your behalf), oldest first. Returns each record's host, type, and value. Any team member, including viewers, can read DNS records. This tool is read-only and does NOT create, change, or delete any DNS record.

name.description: Site name to look up DNS records for.

siteId.description: Site id to look up DNS records for. Provide name or siteId.

name: list_dns_records

records.description: DNS records VibeDeploy tracks for this site, oldest first. Read-only — DNS changes are not made through this tool.

domain.description: The host the record applies to (FQDN).

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, or CUSTOM_VERIFIED (an internal marker for a verified custom domain).

title: List DNS records for a site
